title: TDD keeps authoring whole-suite 'X stays green' ACS meta-predicates that flake red under fleet contention
notes: Root cause CORRECTED 2026-07-27 (console forensics). Two DISTINCT triggers, not one: cycles 1115/1117 = auditor-authored TestZZAudit* probes written into the package under test (see audit-probe-tree-isolation); cycles 1107/1116 = the machine-global /tmp/p project root shared by every concurrent lane (see core-suite-shared-tmp-p-hermeticity, 19521 entries live). The earlier 'width-2 CPU contention' framing was wrong AND the disproof was too: three concurrent `go test ./internal/core/` runs on an idle host cannot reproduce shared-fixed-path contention across lanes. Stronger repo-backed evidence that this is not a simple flake: acssuite.retryFlakyReds (acssuite.go:388-403) already re-runs a red scope once and cycle-1116 lost BOTH rolls. THIS ITEM REMAINS THE STRUCTURAL FIX for both triggers: cycles 1107/1115/1116/1117 each red-flagged ONE whole-suite meta-predicate (ShippedGateSuitesStillGreen / BridgeAndRecoveryStayGreen / CoreAndTopngateSuitesStayGreen) shelling broad `go test ./internal/...`; scoping predicates to the cycle's TOUCHED packages makes them immune to anything a sibling phase or lane does elsewhere in the tree. Note f09ecfc4 scoped the RUNNER's tier; TDD-authored predicates that spawn their own whole-suite subprocesses bypass it. Fix in preference order: (a) eval-quality pre-flight / acssuite lint REJECTS a predicate whose `go test` package args exceed the cycle's touched packages — whole-repo staleness is already covered by the 195-predicate regression suite, so meta-predicates are pure duplication; (b) tdd persona instruction (weakest, drifts). Do NOT raise timeouts — that hides it.
